preconditions.description: The grid must have a length between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == len(grid) for row in grid)
preconditions.description: Each row in the grid must have the same length as the grid.

preconditions.expression: all(cell in {0, 1} for row in grid for cell in row)
preconditions.description: All cells in the grid must be either 0 or 1.

postconditions.expression: stdout == -1 if all(cell == 1 for row in grid for cell in row) else True
postconditions.description: If the grid contains only land, the output must be -1.
The output must be a non-negative integer representing the maximum distance.
The output must be the maximum distance from any water cell to the nearest land cell.
